dialogues.speaker: Laetitia
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two. Are you here to have a look at the clothes, too?

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: It seems Ms. Chiori isn't here today, either.

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: I rarely saw her when I came here before as well. Eloffe tells me that she enjoys making her clothes alone in peace.

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: ...I'm not sure why, but trouble is never far behind whenever Ms. Chiori shows up at the store.

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: Thanks for your concern. We encountered some difficulties at home, but we made it through the fire, and the wedding proceeded as planned. Everyone said it was the most beautiful dress they'd ever seen.

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: Now that I think about it, Ms. Chiori really did help me a whole lot. She often came over to my place with sample dresses for me to try on.

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: She claimed that it was all just to better customize my wedding dress, but she would bring me lots of things every time she came over. She'd ask me how I was doing while sewing and trimming my clothes with needle and thread...

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: Hmm... I'll have to prepare quite a grand thank-you gift for her in return.

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: I'll never tire of looking at Chioriya Boutique's clothes, and they release new styles every so often.

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: If I didn't have to manage business at home, I'd have wanted to work here. It must be lovely to be surrounded by such beautiful clothes every day.

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: Ah, I suppose Ms. Chiori's desire to pursue her dreams must have infected me as well...

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: Should I... try to search for my next dream too?

response.speaker: Laetitia
response.text: It's fine. If there's anything you'd like to chat about, just feel free.
